shared_elements: carved relief on a vertical stone face
frontal or profile ceremonial figures with patterned garments
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures in relief wearing headgear and patterned robes, but A shows a single massive frontal figure in an all-over dense composition of interlocking ornament and glyph-like blocks wrapping a column, while B shows a repeating procession of near-identical profile figures in a horizontal register walking in one direction. The shared content is the generic 'human figure carved in relief'; the specific formal conventions (dense frontal ornamental encrustation vs. spare, repeated profile file) are entirely different.
